aggregate.$comment: Historical 0.0.22 reference sum across 46 publishable manifests; 0.0.23 has 47 and must be remeasured before changing this non-fast-gated baseline.

startup.$comment: Cold-process `import('./dist/index.js')` wall time. Baseline ~37ms; the ceiling is a non-flaky sanity bound that catches catastrophic startup regression, not a tight per-machine target. Plan 071 Task 3: the in-chain gate asserts the machine-relative ratio importMs/processStartMs (denominator = median empty `node -e ""` process start on the same machine in the same run) because external CPU load inflates both numbers together (calibrated 2026-09-12 on 16 CPUs: ratio 3.3 idle at import 58-63ms/process 17-19ms; 3.45-4.05 with a full `npm test` running concurrently; up to 7.2 with 40 competing processes, where the absolute import spiked to 258ms). Off load the tight ratio ceiling (8) and this absolute ceiling are asserted; under load (loadavg-per-CPU >= 1.5) importRatioCeilingUnderLoad (20) replaces the tight ceiling and the absolute bound becomes evidence-of-record in scripts/benchmark.mjs.

benchmarkMedians.$comment: Network-free scenario medians measured by the pre-0.1.3 per-version runners (0.0.15, 100 iterations; reused unchanged by 0.0.16 — 0.0.16 added no performance-affecting code; both consolidated into scripts/benchmark.mjs in plan 015 Task 1). Throughput regression = measured < baseline*(1-tolerance); latency regression = measured > baseline*(1+tolerance).

workflowLoop.$comment: Plan 045 Task 3 network-free workflow-loop evidence: five serial loop iterations, each with one mock-provider node-execution envelope. The 50 ms per-iteration ceiling is intentionally generous for machine-dependent local timing; total p95 ceiling is 250 ms.

phase9.$comment: Release 0.0.26 network-free Phase 9 evidence (plan 009 Task 7). Enumeration: 100k-file synthetic repo, ≤ 2 git invocations per list, results capped at 10k. Process: 1 GiB produced, 64 MiB retained + spill, 50 KiB chunk pages. LSP: 1000-diagnostic normalization at the hard per-file cap. Forge: 100 pages x 100 check-runs, no duplication. Proxy: 64 MiB download at the default response cap, resident buffering ≤ 2x maxBytes. Ceilings match Task 0 freeze. Renderer: 1,000-op A2UI surface stream as 16 snapshot batches of 64 ops + full tree render through the default catalog (Task 14) Sync-path AG-UI mapper: 4,000 events (text/tool/result/message) through the async pipeline with sync hooks only (Task 15).

Fixed fixture: 10 tenants × 10 principals × 1,000 policy/evaluation rows, 10,000 router keys, 16 pool clients, 100 warmups, 1,000 measured operations, and 100-row explicit cleanup batches. All ceilings are milliseconds and intentionally match Phase 6's 50ms indexed-point and 100ms page/cleanup ceilings.

nonNullAssertions.$comment: Plan 071 Task 9 (plan 070 FA 2). `style/noNonNullAssertion` is an error repo-wide in biome.json and switched back off per directory through `overrides`; the allowlisted directories are exactly the byPath keys below and the in-chain scripts/budget-gate.test.mjs asserts that set equality, that each directory stays at or under its recorded count, that a directory reaching zero must drop its allowlist entry, that no site appears outside the allowlist, and that the plan-070 named clusters re-enabled as errors (biome.json's last override) stay at zero. Lower a number when you sweep; raising one needs a recorded reason here — the ceiling only ratchets down. Measured 2026-09-12 with `node_modules/.bin/biome lint --only=style/noNonNullAssertion --reporter=json .` on Biome 2.5.13 (Node v24.19.0/Linux x64); sites include test files.
